diagnostic.label: no-ribbons
diagnostic.description: Suppress ribbon scene creation/collection/custom painting; retain travel, reading styles and controls.

diagnostic.label: no-canvas-draw
diagnostic.description: Omit shape submission only; retain clearRect, projection, effects, sorting and the scene clock.

diagnostic.label: model-prewarm
diagnostic.description: Expose an explicit measured Writing room/palette preparation before navigation; include its cost in the result.

diagnostic.label: thematic-off
diagnostic.description: Omit Writing thematic objects during projection only; retain all room construction/palette work and other routes.

diagnostic.label: shared-off
diagnostic.description: Omit Writing shared objects during projection only; retain all room construction/palette work and other routes.

diagnostic.label: edge-bypass
diagnostic.description: Do not install edge-scroll hooks; retain content-flight preference, travel, styles and ordinary header navigation.

decision: Retain supported source correction for reduced mobile cold blocking and exact geometry. Both controls and candidates pass on this faster host; no pass-from-fail, FCP/steady-paint/flight-duration or full-release claim.
